verses.text: People make plans in their hearts, but the answer that comes out of their mouths comes from the LORD.
You can look at everything you do and think it's all clean. The LORD weighs what drove you to do it.
Put what you do in the LORD's hands, and your plans will stand.
The LORD made everything for its own purpose, even the wicked for the day disaster comes.
The LORD can't stand a proud heart. You can count on it, proud people will face punishment.
Mercy and truth make atonement for wrongdoing. When people stand in awe of the LORD, they turn away from evil.
When the way you live pleases the LORD, he makes peace between you and even your enemies.
Better to have a little and do right than rake in money by treating people unfairly.
You plan the road in your heart, but the LORD directs the steps you take.
Inspired judgments are on a king's lips. When he gives a ruling, he must speak true.
Honest scales belong to the LORD. Every weight in the bag is his work.
Doing wrong ought to disgust kings. A throne stands firm through justice.
Kings are glad to hear people speak what's right. They value someone who tells them the truth.
When the king is furious, death could be on its way. A wise person knows how to calm him down.
There's life in the light on a king's face. His favor is like a cloud bringing spring rain.
Getting wisdom beats getting gold by a mile. If it's understanding or silver, choose understanding.
The road honest people take leads away from evil. Watch where you're going and you'll keep your life safe.
Pride shows up before the crash. An arrogant spirit comes right before the fall.
Better to stay humble among poor people than split the loot with the proud.
Pay attention to the word and things will go well. Blessed is anyone who trusts the LORD.
People with wise hearts are known for good judgment. Pleasant words help a lesson sink in.
Understanding is a fountain of life for whoever has it. A fool's own foolishness is their punishment.
A wise heart teaches the mouth what to say and puts more learning into every word.
Kind words are like honeycomb, sweet to the soul and good for the bones. 🍯
Some roads look right when you start out, but follow them to the end and they take you straight to death.
A worker's appetite works right alongside them. Hunger keeps them going.
A troublemaker digs up ways to do harm. The words they say burn like fire.
A crooked person gets fights going. Someone who whispers behind people's backs can split up close friends.
A violent person lures their neighbor along and takes them down a road that leads to no good.
That wink gives away the twisted thing they're planning. When they press their lips together, they're bent on doing harm.
Gray hair is a crown of glory earned on the road of doing right.
Staying slow to anger beats being a mighty warrior. Ruling your own spirit beats taking a city.
You can toss the lot into your lap, but every result comes from the LORD.
